messages:
rebecca_p: Quick PM-FU from the KV eviction postmortem: we need owners + dates for regression tests, a weekly canary, expanded eval promptsets, a short load spike, and a monthly chaos drill. Short replies pls with owner + ETA.

samir: I can own the eval promptset (EVAL-999). Will add long-prefix, repeat-token, and streaming truncation cases + fuzzy thresholds. PR by 05/04, eval run 05/06.

cheng_z: I'll take the regression tests. Plan: tests/kv_repro/ with 6 deterministic repros and a smoke pre-deploy. PR by 05/03. Smoke curl: `curl -s -X POST https://staging.api.redwood/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"kv_warm_check"}'`

ops-lucy: Ops will run the weekly canary and the monthly chaos drill. Canary: Mon 02:00 UTC, 10m lightweight burst. Chaos: third Tue/month in staging, 20m at 2x burst + single-worker reboot mid-spike. First canary wired 05/05, first chaos 05/19.

qa-jen: I'll own CI gating. Add `kv-evict-canary` job that runs weekly and block merges if regressions show. Need Cheng's test filenames and Samir's goldens to set thresholds. ETA gating live: 05/10.

incident-bot: created TASK-PLAT-2100: "kv eviction follow-up: regressions, canary, evals, chaos" assigned to cheng_z.

rebecca_p: Owner recap: cheng_z -> regression tests (TASK-PLAT-2100), samir -> eval promptset (EVAL-999), ops-lucy -> canary + chaos (TASK-OPS-900), qa-jen -> CI gating. Please add PR links to TASK-PLAT-2100 as you open them. Weekly check-ins until closed.

samir: I'll include both token and sequence scoring and a kv_miss_regression metric in the eval harness.

cheng_z: Will push PR and README with local run commands: `pytest tests/kv_repro -k repro -q`.

qa-jen: :thumbsup: I'll add flaky detection and an alert that pages oncall if canary fails 2x in a row.

ops-lucy: I'll publish the runbook in #eng-oncall before the first canary.

rebecca_p: Thanks all. Closing thread unless blockers.
